headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Q3 Earnings Ride Bitcoin Windfall As Funding Risks Linger
headlines.summary: Strategy entered this Q3 2026 release with a bruised share chart over the past month, yet the stock jumped 3.7% today to US$135.63. That reaction sits against a quarter defined by one thing above all else: a huge profit swing powered by Bitcoin fair value gains that pushed net income to about US$19.1b and basic earnings per share to roughly US$47.78. For a business long treated as a leveraged Bitcoin vehicle, the expectation was volatility.

headlines.title: 59% Upside for Strategy? Maxim Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMaxim Group kept its Buy rating and $215 target on Strategy on Nov. 3, 59% above the stock, which is down 49% from its high a year ago.

headlines.title: Strategy’s Bitcoin Bet Just Produced a Monster Quarter. Here’s the Bigger Question.
headlines.summary: Strategy Inc. just posted one of the most jaw-dropping earnings beats in recent memory, yet the stock is falling and bitcoin keeps sliding further from its peak. Whether the company's capital-raising machine can survive rising preferred dividends and dilution is the question every investor needs to answer before touching this trade.

headlines.title: Is Strategy (MSTR) Still Doubling Down On Bitcoin With A $65 Million Move?
headlines.summary: Strategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) acquired more than US$65 million of Bitcoin during the recent market turmoil following the Binance hack. The latest Bitcoin purchase came as security concerns across the wider crypto sector drew renewed attention from equity investors. The new Bitcoin allocation reinforces Strategy's treasury-focused Bitcoin approach while the broader industry responds to the Binance breach.

headlines.title: Strategy Stock Fell 15% in October: Is MSTR Crashing or Just Finding a Bottom?
headlines.summary: Strategy just bought more bitcoin days after a brutal October selloff, even as Coinbase and MARA took far steeper losses. Whether that confidence signals a turning point or a deeper trap depends on one fragile part of the company's funding model.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
